description: This file defines an interface for activity check configuration settings, including methods to retrieve inactivity and deletion intervals, along with an enumeration of known configuration values with default durations.

classes.name: ActivityCheckConfig
classes.description: Immutable interface providing configuration for entity activity checks, including methods to get inactive and deleted intervals.

classes.name: ActivityCheckConfig.ActivityCheckConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default duration values for activity check settings.

methods.name: getInactiveInterval
methods.description: Returns the duration for which an inactive entity remains in memory.

methods.name: getDeletedInterval
methods.description: Returns the duration for which a deleted entity remains in memory.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value associated with this configuration enum entry.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path string for this known config value.
